verify.metaDescription: Recompute server-verified DEMO slot rounds in your browser with the revealed seed.
verify.title: Round verification
verify.lead: For server-verified DEMO rounds, the hash of the server seed is shown before the round is played. Once the seed is revealed, this page recomputes the round seed (HMAC-SHA256), the engine's entire round and the payout in your browser. This is not a certified RNG; DEMO credit has no value.
verify.historyText: The last 50 rounds of this tab's server session. Rounds of an unrevealed seed show “Seed not revealed”; “Reveal seed” reveals the current seed and switches to a new one.
verify.noteNoServer: The server is not configured in this build (NEXT_PUBLIC_API_URL).
verify.noteNoSession: There is no server-verified session in this tab. Play a game in server mode first.
verify.noteEmpty: No server rounds in this session yet.
verify.noteRevealed: The server seed was revealed and a new one is now active. Earlier rounds can now be verified.

replay.metaDescription: Watch a server-signed DEMO slot round again, without any balance.
replay.title: Shared round
replay.noServer: The sharing server is not configured in this build.
replay.notFound: This share was not found or has expired.
replay.heading: {game} · shared round
replay.lead: The round record signed by the server; it contains no balance, time or session data. The round was rebuilt in your browser with the same engine from the recorded seed. DEMO credit has no value.
replay.board: Grid, {count} winning {unit, select, ebru {drops} cezeri {segments} asena {stars} other {stones}}
replay.noSteps: The steps of this round cannot be shown.
